businesses.business: civil infrastructure and site development services

offering_description.value: Provides civil infrastructure and site development services that self-perform grading, underground utilities, drilling, blasting and paving for residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects across the Southeast.

quotes.quote: Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.
Aviator Paving delivers full-service grading and paving solutions, using the highest-quality materials through our wholly owned asphalt plant.
Allied Paving is a heavy site and roadway construction company that specializes in crushed stone base, asphalt paving and milling for Georgia development projects.
